decisions.reason: The accepted day/month/year date display format does not change help-label text, access, persistence, or placement.
The date display format does not alter the visual cues or empty-field visibility required for editable fields.
Formatting selected dates as day/month/year does not change whether placeholders clear when fields are activated.
The source decision concerns date display formatting and does not change the representation or robustness of ordinary text-entry fields.
The accepted date format does not affect normal-Enter support, multiline entry, or hard-return spacing.
The date display format does not change the required spacing between field text and the right-side line.
The day/month/year value format does not replace or otherwise change the Danish date placeholder or other interface text.
Bullet sizing, alignment, balance, reference design, and color are unrelated to the accepted date display format.
The date display format does not change which theme colors are included or available.
Although both apply to the Board Meeting template, date formatting does not affect the behavior of inserting lines after agenda topics.
The accepted date format does not change fixed-margin or pencil-icon containment behavior in the Guidance template.
The source decision establishes a date display format but does not resolve or alter legacy copy-paste layout and style behavior.
